name: Network Latency
description: Variation in network latency between the controller and the servers could cause delays in updating the shared counter, resulting in multimodal latencies.

name: Server Load
description: Asymmetric server loads could cause delays in processing coin flip requests, leading to multimodal latencies.

name: Controller Load
description: The controller's processing power and load could impact the time it takes to make decisions on which server to flip the coin next.

name: Server Clock Skew
description: Differences in server clock times could cause discrepancies in the perceived latency of coin flips between servers.

name: Network Congestion
description: Network congestion could cause delays in transmitting coin flip requests and responses between the controller and the servers.

name: Coin Flip Request Queue Length
description: The length of the queue of pending coin flip requests could impact the latency of processing these requests.

name: Server Restart or Failover
description: Sudden server restarts or failovers could cause temporary delays in processing coin flip requests.

name: Controller Restart or Failover
description: Sudden controller restarts or failovers could impact the system's ability to make timely decisions on which server to flip the coin next.

name: Power Outage or Intermittent Power
description: Power outages or intermittent power could impact the system's ability to process coin flip requests in a timely manner.

name: Temperature or Environmental Factors
description: Extreme temperatures or other environmental factors could impact the system's performance and cause delays in processing coin flip requests.

name: Clock Synchronization Issues
description: Issues with clock synchronization between the controller and the servers could cause discrepancies in the perceived latency of coin flips.

name: Operating System or Software Issues
description: Issues with the operating system or software running on the servers or controller could cause delays in processing coin flip requests.

name: Hardware Issues
description: Hardware issues with the servers or controller could cause delays in processing coin flip requests.

name: Human Error or Interventions
description: Human error or interventions could impact the system's performance and cause delays in processing coin flip requests.

name: Other System Interactions or Dependencies
description: Other system interactions or dependencies could impact the system's performance and cause delays in processing coin flip requests.
